The problem with the US is that the culture carriers are extremely uncool.

They don't have an ounce of coolness in their DNA.

Everyone suffers from systems that feed on attention and performance. Even the people that build them. Even though they're making money from their creations.

Cool people don't care. They just don't fucking care about the photo or the likes or the opportunities to grift. And they resent the erosion of private experience. 

The lack of coolness doesn't get enough attention.
